t_m.text: Share and invite: how clubs market for us.

s_a.text:
Good for: the president's setup; one place for everything.

Costs: a new place to find (a "Your club" item in the nav), apart from where officers talk.

Size: medium.

s_b.text:
My pick, with D's event stages on Up next and the share kit.

Good for: daily running; phone officers finally get members, followers and requests (the Club tools sheet).

Costs: setup and numbers are tighter; the public page stays separate.

Size: smallest.

s_c.text:
Good for: setup and marketing; what officers make is what visitors see. Events tab first.

Costs: running the night (check-in, posting) still means going to Messages.

Size: medium.

s_d.text:
Good for: event-led clubs; each event shows its next step, from posted to thank-you.

Costs: clubs that mostly talk get less; the biggest build.

Size: largest.

s_m.text:
Shared by every option.

The members' link (call 3) and the story cards (call 7) are new: both need your yes. Cards carry no names or faces, and a count shows only from 5 up.
